notes.title: Vigor - Tempest Update 24.0
notes.notes:
Main Features & New Additions
Tempest Season has arrived to the Battle Pass

Experience new Elimination arenas on Batterie Draug

Put your skills to the test in the new Challenge System

The hotly-requested PP-19 joins the fight

New Seasonal Halloween event added

Express yourself with brand-new gestures

Stalk your prey with the Bayou Reaper Pack


Gameplay & Visuals
Added: Matchmaking time information is now available in the Outlands tab

Added: Consumable Crate

Added: Time-limited Event Challenges (Airdrop Hunt, Outlands Duty, Terminal Call, Halloween Hunt)

Changed: The preview pictures of Crafting Plans

Changed: Crafting Boost price now changes according to the time remaining

Changed: Challenges System reworked, with improvements to daily and seasonal challenges

Changed: Improved Unexploded Missile sounds

Changed: General UI polish and improvements

Changed: UI improvements to the Crafting Tab

Tweaked: When playing Halloween Hunt, Consumables can be used while the player is in mid-air (e.g. healing won't get interrupted when falling down)

Fixed: Various bugs affecting Cosmetics

Fixed: Unexploded Missile not spawning properly

Fixed: 'Weapon Expert' Achievement not counting some weapon plans towards completion

Fixed: Several networking issues

Fixed: General Client and Server stability

Bug Reports[p align="start"]Found a bug not listed here? Let us know through our Feedback Tracker:

https://feedback.bistudio.com/project/view/80/

notes.title: Vigor hotfix patch 23.1
notes.notes:
Changelog:


 Fixed: Weapon swap button would not always select the secondary weapon
 Fixed: Unexploded missile was not rewarding XP. It now awards 200 XP upon successful defusal
 Fixed: Removed invisible collisions on Fjellkanten and Brodalen Bridges, making parts of the maps inaccessible
 Fixed: Holograms of consumable items would not disappear sometimes
 Fixed: Unfinished house interior on Grontheim is no longer accessible
 Fixed: When a player dies from the Unexploded Missile radiation, the correct cause of death is shown in the Rewards Screen
 Fixed: Crafting prompt when loading a preset containing a missing item did not work
 Fixed: Crafting challenge for Impact Grenades could be completed by crafting other consumables as well

notes.title: Vigor - Turmoil Update 23.0
notes.notes:
Main Features & New Additions
Turmoil Season has arrived to the Battle Pass

Dare to loot the new Unexploded Missile Loot Event in Encounters

New visualization of the Radiation wave in Encounters

Strike fast with the new Impact Grenade

Regular Carnage Events will spice up Shootout (Blade Carnage, Hunters Carnage, Weapon Carnage, Pioneer Carnage)

Crafting System reworked

New Seasonal Challenges added

New Premium Pack: Annihilator


Gameplay & Visuals
Added: Ammo Press Shelter Improvement

Added: Bulk Crafting of Weapons and Consumables

Added: Season 23 Action Figure

Added: Wraith of the North Pack

Changed: Crafting Table now provides Crafting Boost

Changed: Crafting UI reworked (Crafting tab is now located under the Outlands tab, separate from the Equip tab)

Changed: Ammo crafting no longer requires ownership of a Weapon Plan for a compatible weapon

Changed: Visuals of the Radiation Wave (both in the sky and map UI)

Changed: Battle Pass levels and rewards reworked (now contains 50 levels, plus 25 extra levels)

Changed: It is now possible to assign one Cosmetic to multiple Wardrobe presets

Changed: Conditions of several Challenges

Changed: Crates in Shootout now have Weapons that are already loaded

Changed: Crates in Shootout now display their content when player is close to them

Changed: Improved sounds for opening the Locked Container

Changed: Removed Crafting Table level requirement for crafting weapons from Weapon Plans

Changed: Shootout scores have been reworked

Tweaked: Improved Featured Store visuals and UI

Tweaked: Throwing arcs of throwable Consumables have been improved

Tweaked: La Tomatina Tomato visuals (tomato size increased and now shows a red trail when thrown)

Fixed: 9mm Parabellum ammo was too heavy

Fixed: Some Action Figures could not be picked up

Fixed: Bleeding condition randomly disappeared

Fixed: Fiske Fabrikk tunnel collisions that meant the Timed Safe could not be opened

Fixed: Multiple crash occurrences

Fixed: Phone duel did not grant XP for winning if the opponent left the match

Fixed: Several keyboard input related bugs

Fixed: Throwable Consumables disappeared mid-flight on some maps

Fixed: Issues affecting various Cosmetic items


Bug Reports
Found a bug not listed here? Let us know through our Feedback Tracker:

https://feedback.bistudio.com/project/view/80/

notes.title: Vigor - Meltdown Update 22.0
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=gLC6gqGQkdQ;full][/previewyoutube]


Main Features & New Additions


 Meltdown Season has arrived to the Battle Pass
 Remember previous Seasons with new Action Figure collectibles

 New Premium Pack: Doomsday Raider

 Added: New sounds for the Locked Container

 Changed: Scoreboards reworked for Elimination and Shootout
 Changed: Rifle category split into Rifle and Sniper Rifle categories
 Changed: Maximum limit for resources is now 999,999,999
 Tweaked: XP value of extracted resources now better reflects their rarity

 Fixed: "Last Played With" list updating in real time during an Encounter
 Fixed: Mixed buttons for Booby Trap defusal

notes.title: 21.0 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hei Outlanders,

Today we pushed out a hotfix to address the crashes that have been happening across multiple game modes. 
You should have a smoother experience now, but if the game keeps crashing for you, please let us know through the Feedback Tracker: https://feedback.bistudio.com/project/view/80/

notes.title: A new patch brings fixes to the Outlands!
notes.notes:
Hei Outlanders,

We're bringing some fixes to the Outlands! With a focus on crashes and improving your experience in-game, here is the changelog for this patch:


 Shelter UI to prevent getting stuck in different screens/menus
 Server-side fixes to lessen crashes
 Overlay fixes
 Addition of Consumable Plans to the Store


Keep the feedback rolling so that we can keep on working on fixes behind the scenes. See you in the Outlands!

notes.title: The Full Release Is Coming Next Week!
notes.notes:
Hei Outlanders! 🍅

The time has come. The full free-to-play release of Vigor is arriving next week! You can still get your hands on the Reinforcements Pack, now 50% off on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/sub/1046264/

It includes a uniform, unique title, weapons, and consumables that you’ll keep in the full release.

You can also look forward to a brand-new Season—Vigor Chronicles: Genesis. Read more about it below, and watch the trailer that reveals the theme.

[previewyoutube=hq0zTpCopaM;full][/previewyoutube]

Unfold the Chronicles and revel in this genesis! A new era has reached the Outlands, full of new and exciting possibilities! In this update, you can explore Eikevjen in Encounters, take a shot at the new Weapon Overhaul, and progress through a Battle Pass inspired by 80s action movies.

We can't wait to meet you all in the Outlands! Are you ready to survive the apocalypse?
